title: I would so its okay
text: I would say this is an okay purchase, we received our first box a week ago , my son is 4 and was not impressed by anything that came in the box, the age says 4-8 but I could foresee the toys being for an older kid as like collectables or something. we are going to wait until the November box comes before deciding whether or not to continue it monthly or cancel it.
label: negative
